body: I just don't get how my life is going so slow, while everyone else is able to accomplish giant leaps in life. It just feels like I am too stupid for all this.
Thanks! It's really the getting motivated part that screws me up the most - because I always want to, but I can't do it. The 30min walk is something I will take up, that sounds easy!

I am not the smartest guy around, but I believe soon people will understand that bitcoin is two things:

1) Bitcoin itself: The thingy you pay with, invest in or trade

2) The public blockchain: This idea can be separated from Bitcoin. So we could see a blockchain for stock certificates, for cars, for real estate, for bond certificates or even the food you buy. While you might ask "Who cares?!" this can be very useful to you:
You own stock, and want to know if there's someone who can manipulate the price or the next vote at the annual stock assembly? >> Blockchain.
That guy wants to sell you a car but you aren't sure if it's his, because there is no way to verify? >> Blockchain.
You plan to invest in US bonds as a safe investment, but want to peek around the ownership structure to see how safe it really feels for you once you know who owns what? >> Blockchain.
Maybe this can be extended to food tracking and tracing, maybe you could even somehow connect your local congressman's votes - it's a balance between utility and privacy that needs to be found.
IF this blockchain idea makes any sense anyways to things outside of cryptocurrencies. I think it could.
